organizations.publicNote: German recording company active from 1925 to 1972; the linked discs use Electrola as their imprint. In 1972 Electrola-Gesellschaft and Carl Lindström GmbH were merged into the successor company EMI Electrola. The designation E.G. belongs to a record series, not to the organization’s name.

sources.shortCitation: Electrola E.G. 2532, “Ganz ohne Liebe wär’ das Leben so bescheiden”
sources.fullCitation: Marek Weber und sein Orchester. “Ganz ohne Liebe wär’ das Leben so bescheiden.” Fox-trot with refrain vocal; label credits music to Jurmann and Kaper and words to Fritz Rotter. Electrola E.G. 2532, 1932. Digital transfer on YouTube. Accessed 21 August 2026.

sources.researchNote: The upload description gives matrix OD 879-2, places the session in Berlin around March 1932 and tentatively suggests John Hendrik as the refrain singer. The label is not shown, and the singer identification remains unconfirmed.
